Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class MfaConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.MfaConfiguration
@Configuration(value="mfaWebConfiguration", proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableMultiFactorAuthentication(authorities={}) public class MfaConfiguration extends Object
Wires multi-factor authentication: Spring Security's multi-factor support (it enables the entry points for a missing factor authority; the factors are not required globally, because the MfaAuthorizationManager requires them only when the client or the user asks for it), the registry of AuthenticationFactor beans, the policy manager, and its application to the login chain and to /oauth2/authorize.

A login method adds its factor by declaring an AuthenticationFactor bean (see PasswordFactor); nothing here is edited.
